_comment: Editorial content for AKDHL. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available.
description: AKD Hospitality Limited, formerly AKD Capital Limited, was incorporated as a public limited company in 1936 and its shares are quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Its stated mandate spans hospitality, motels, destination management and tourism attractions.
sourceNote: Written from the company's own site, https://akdhospitality.com (1936 incorporation, PSX quotation, hospitality/motels/destination management/tourism mandate, and the former name AKD Capital Limited, which the exchange profile at https://dps.psx.com.pk/company/AKDHL also records) (accessed 2026-10-17). The site could not be loaded from this host at write time beyond its published summary, and no address, telephone, chief executive or product list was available from a permitted source, so those fields are null.
